name: Costco Mira Loma Depot, Mira Loma CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driver reviews describe checking in at a guard shack ('get in the left lane at the guard shack') and a kiosk for some check-ins; site is fully hedge/chain-link secured on all public frontages with one main controlled truck apron opening off the north I-15 frontage road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed by driver reviews: staffed booth where drivers check in, receive paperwork and a pager. Sits at the pinch point of the north-central entrance apron.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trailers and bobtails stage along the I-15 frontage road and along the south road outside the gate (visible parked at the curb in Street View and satellite).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved holding apron inside the gate between the north building and the main building before trucks reach dock doors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on multiple building faces: north building south face, main solar building east/west finger faces and south face - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound lanes at the guard shack from driver 'left lane' reference; not directly countable from overhead due to tree cover over the gate.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated; exit shares the same gate group (entry/exit together).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron off the frontage road with ample paved width to add an express/appointment bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 150 is an honest overhead estimate across the north building (both faces) and the multi-finger main solar building (east, west and south dock faces); roof solar panels obscure exact counts - band 50+ is firm.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers parked in angled rows across drop yards on every building face; capacity ~750, band 50+ is firm.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~92 acres derived from the traced perimeter (cold + ~670k sq ft dry building plus extensive trailer yards).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two primary structures: north building and the large connected main cold+dry depot (solar-roofed). The white-roofed DC to the east is a separate property and excluded.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire industrial fabric (Jurupa Valley/Mira Loma) directly on I-15; Urban.

citations.claim: Official Costco careers locator lists 'MIRA LOMA (WET DEPOT), CA' at 11600 Riverside Drive as a current hiring location.
Project engineer portfolio documents the Mira Loma DC: 670k sq ft dry + 201k sq ft cold + 75k sq ft cold expansion.

verification.rationale: Costco careers locator names the exact-address 'Mira Loma WET DEPOT'; large cross-dock DC, not a club; no closure/relocation found.
